description.p: Faustica is a modern writing suite for hobby authors and everyone who loves to write and appreciates a calm, well-organized writing environment. On Linux, Faustica is free.

At the heart of Faustica is the editor: write and format your text, insert images, add comments, and keep track of your writing progress. A focus mode helps you hide distractions and concentrate entirely on your text.

You manage characters, locations and much more directly in your project (Compendium), while mind maps, timelines and notes help you organize ideas, capture connections and keep track of your story. Repetition detection, synonyms and comments help with revising, and versions and automatic backups keep earlier drafts safe.
Your projects remain stored locally on your device. No AI. No cloud. No subscription.

ul.li: Offline and private: no cloud, no account, no AI
Rich text editor with focus mode, split-screen view and spell checking
Compendium for characters, places and more, including a relationship graph
Timeline, mind maps and note boards
Export as Word, PDF, EPUB and Markdown; import from Word and Markdown
Automatic version history and encrypted backups
28 interface languages, including Arabic and Hebrew
